title: 1 WHAT THE RIGHT HAND OF GOD SIGNIFIETH.

segments.text: THE right hande of God ſignifieth, 1 The omnipotency, or exceeding vertue of God. Act. 5.31. Him hath God lift vp with his right hand to be a Prince and a Sauiour. 2 It ſignifieth perfect glorie, perfect dignitie, and full diuine maieſtie.
